source_evidence.support: The original explicitly derives a scalar quadratic exponential envelope, transfers on one self-adjoint matrix, takes positive expectation, cancels centering, and applies I+A<=exp(A). It states that the method parallels a classical scalar method.

regions: C.2 Ex107-121 and adjacent actual consumers
source_evidence.support: Downstream Gaussian bounded-summand context only. Its unnamed Bernstein use is not treated as an explicit original citation to Tropp or as proof of the complete tail through this conceptual bridge.

hypothesis_audit.scalar: Probability measure; measurable/integrable x and x squared; a.s. x<=1; Ex=0; s>0. These suffice for the indicated scalar expectation route; exp(sx) integrability follows from the upper cap.
hypothesis_audit.matrix: Finite real self-adjoint random matrix, source-standing genuine Bochner expectations of X and X squared, a.s. X<=I, actual EX=0, s>0. Same-operator spectral transfer and PSD-positive averaging replace scalar pointwise order and scalar averaging.
hypothesis_audit.gaussian_adapter: The actual code derives its normalized signed-weight application hypotheses internally from the original product Gaussian law and existing source parents. This source mechanism does not turn those ingredients into new Gaussian public premises.

estimate_and_conclusion_audit.scalar_envelope: For all real x<=1 and s>0, exp(sx)<=1+sx+(exp(s)-s-1)x squared. The negative half-line and removable value at x=0 are covered by the original remainder argument.
estimate_and_conclusion_audit.matrix_envelope: The same scalar functions are evaluated at one self-adjoint X; no arbitrary-pair matrix exponential monotonicity is used.
estimate_and_conclusion_audit.expectation: Positive averaging and centering yield Eexp(sX)<=I+g(s)E(X squared), followed by I+C<=exp(C) for that self-adjoint C.
estimate_and_conclusion_audit.scalar_to_matrix_status: The one-dimensional commuting case explains the conceptual correspondence. The proposal expressly does not emit or certify a formal scalar-to-1x1 adapter, equivalence theorem or functor.

failure_boundary_audit.negative_parameters: Correctly excluded: a one-sided upper cap does not control an arbitrarily negative tail at negative s.
failure_boundary_audit.covariance_cover: Correctly warns against placing an arbitrary Loewner second-moment upper cover inside exp; general matrix exp is not operator monotone.
failure_boundary_audit.noncommuting_sums: Correctly requires additional actual joint-law and legitimate sum-Laplace machinery, rather than an unsupported product-MGF factorization.
failure_boundary_audit.tail_and_main_results: No independence, probability tail, Gaussian C.6, oracle or cost conclusion is credited by this bridge.
